rereport.closure_text: Case Closed. Closed date : 2016-04-26 08:29:32.07 Case Noted Thank you for your request for a new ramp at Monson Street & Temple Street.  Yes I do sense your sarcasm  but I assure you that we take every request serious.    When the City receives a request  we go out and make the sidewalk safe using asphalt.  This repair is only temporary!      As you might or might not know there is a 18-24 month turn around on some requests.  This appears to be a ramp with less than 6 feet of sidewalk on Monson Street.  To properly repair the sidewalk  it will require detailed engineering and surveying to determine the correct slope of the pedestrian ramp to make it compliant with the ADA.    Fortunately  we will be working on a nearby street (Old Morton) and I will come over and design this and construct a new ramp at this location.  I will also put a bollard on the corner so that the "CAPITAL WASTE" trucks do not drive on the corners  but currently  the contracts for this year have not been awarded.  When the contracts are awarded and we are in South Dorchester  this will be one of the first locations that I will take care of.    Feel free to reach out and contact me with any questions that you might have regarding this sidewalk or any sidewalk and I will do my best to help you.    Thank you again for bringing this matter to our attention.    If you have any further questions  or feel that this case was closed in error  please do not hesitate to contact me.    Michael Somers  Senior Civil Engineer  Construction Management Division  Boston Public Works  [removed]	  [removed]
